resources.string: Move your phone slowly to find the floor, then aim the circle at a corner and tap Add point.
Aim at the next corner along the wall and tap Add point to measure the length.
Length %1$s. Now aim at the corner across the room and tap Add point for the width.
Length %1$s · Width %2$s. Slide your finger up the screen until the line reaches the ceiling.
Length %1$s · Width %2$s · Height %3$s. Tap Send to calculator, or slide again to adjust.
Aim the circle at the floor until it turns solid white.
This phone doesn\'t support Google Play Services for AR.
The camera is busy. Close other camera apps and try again.
Calcupine Measure needs the camera to measure.
